parsed.explanation: Combined federal and division regimes impose universal document and facilities exposure: binary passport policy, visa refusal for discrepancy with possible lifetime fraud ineligibility, and bans on identity-congruent government facilities, with a documented trespass arrest. If outed in this division, a visitor faces birth-sex men's-jail placement despite a female licence marker, male-guard search, denied hospital care, and a mob attack in which victims were charged and no attacker arrested. National custody policies document hormone removal, forced labour, beatings and sexual abuse. Federal courts, hate-crime and employment rulings, and enjoined orders provide partial recourse, but the division has no gender-identity discrimination law, its hate-crime statute excludes gender identity, and is in the lowest policy band. No execution pathway is documented; imprisonment, custody abuse and exclusion are credible.

entry_documents.exposure: Binary sex policy from Jan 2025; X-markers stopped Feb 2025, Supreme Court allowed Nov 2025; passports confiscated/blocked reported. Visa cable: document discrepancy requires refusal and additional evidence; suspected wilful misrepresentation can support permanent lifetime ineligibility. Allied advisories and neighbouring-citizen detentions followed.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports valid until expiration; civil-liberties suit on behalf of seven plaintiffs unresolved; limited waiver possibilities for fraud finding.
entry_documents.interaction: Document discrepancy at entry can become refusal, stranding, or a fraud allegation with lifetime consequences, interacting with state document rules that may invalidate non-matching licences/birth certificates.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Division incident: held in men's jail and searched by male guard despite female licence marker; marker did not determine housing/search. National corrections from 2026 adopt hair-cutting, hormone removal and psychiatric substitution; immigration custody reports forced labour, beatings, solitary and severe sexual abuse of transgender men. Trespass arrest example carried up to 60 days.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Pretrial release in trespass example; courts have enjoined several executive orders; no documented custody-placement protection for visitors in this division.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Restroom encounter leads to arrest, then birth-sex custody and search, replicating the documented men's-jail outcome rather than identity-based placement.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: National order bars government-funded single-sex facilities congruent with identity. 9 states plus one prohibit in all government buildings, 9 cover schools plus some government buildings, 3 schools-only; 4 make use a criminal trespass offence after refusal to depart. Division has a severe municipal restroom ordinance; no statewide facilities statute is documented.
federal_state_facilities.protection: 29 states, 4 units and capital district have no ban in mapped categories; trespass statute has exemptions and requires willful entry plus refusal to depart, not automatic arrest.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Federal facility rule and state/municipal bans layer: a visitor may have lawful access in some settings yet face exclusion, police call, arrest and birth-sex custody in government buildings or this municipality.

care_services.exposure: Division banned minors' puberty blockers, hormones and surgery from 1 Jan 2024. Nationally 27 states ban minors' care, proposed federal rules would bar insurance for under-18s, and custody removes hormone medication. Division mob victim was denied hospital care.
care_services.protection: Adult routine care ban is not_documented; several orders have been blocked or enjoined, leaving exact operative scope uncertain.
care_services.interaction: A travelling minor or parent seeking continuity of care can face state ban, school/facility rules, and federal funding restrictions simultaneously; custody or emergency admission risks outing and hormone interruption.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Executive order defines sex as binary at birth and removes gender-identity policies; justice department uses 'radical gender ideology' in extremism guidance; May 2026 counterterrorism strategy prioritises 'radically pro-transgender' groups; 66% poll support for assigned-sex documents. Unenforceable sodomy statute up to 5 years remains as secondary signal.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Same-sex marriage recognised nationwide; 2020 ruling prohibits gender-identity employment discrimination; national hate-crime statute covers gender identity; some orders enjoined.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Hostile federal framing interacts with division's lowest policy band and absence of state gender-identity protections, reducing local official discretion to protect a visitor.

minors_guardians.exposure: Division bars transgender girls from public-school sports; schools are covered by many facility bans; January 2025 order directs investigation and criminal prosecution of teachers facilitating social transition including names/pronouns; minors' care banned in division and 27 states.
minors_guardians.protection: Several orders blocked or enjoined; no documented visitor-specific exemption for travelling minors.
minors_guardians.interaction: A parent travelling with a minor risks school/facility exclusion, care denial, and investigation/prosecution exposure for adults facilitating transition, with consequences for the child.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Aug 2026 mob beat transgender couple over restroom use; both victims charged with disturbing the peace, no attacker arrested that day per sheriff, one denied hospital care and taken to men's jail. State asks not to treat the per-capita killing figure, described as an undercount floor and close to the safest state's rate, as a measured trans-specific rate.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Federal hate-crime statute applies, but division's 1997 statute covers sexual orientation only, not gender identity, so local bias enhancement is absent.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Police response itself becomes exposure: victim arrest and non-arrest of attackers signals no effective street-level protection in this division despite federal statute.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No state law prohibiting gender-identity discrimination in employment, housing or public accommodations; lowest gender-identity and overall policy band; only 23 states cover gender identity in bias statutes nationally. Victim plea outcome, statewide facilities position, and adult care rules unresolved.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Federal courts hear passport and executive-order challenges; legal-aid FAQ exists; two municipalities prohibit gender-identity discrimination, others protect only public employees.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Municipal protections do not cancel state absence or federal entry/facility/custody rules; absence of documented remedy for the mob/custody incident leaves recourse uncertain.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar to 0.25-C: birth-sex prison housing with assault risk, slow remedies and solitary as protection. This case also has that custody placement in the men's-jail incident plus federal conversion-therapy custody policies, so it sits near this anchor rather than materially above it.

Lower than 0.35-B: that anchor has hours-long detention and fines but imprisonment uncommon. Here detention includes men's-jail placement, male-guard search, hormone removal, reported forced labour and sexual abuse in immigration custody, and a possible lifetime visa bar — more severe and more universal.

Clearly lower than 0.55-B: that anchor is mainly administrative secondary screening, refused admission and slow appeals without custody abuse. Here document discrepancy can trigger refusal/fraud ineligibility, facilities bans can trigger arrest, and custody is by birth sex, with documented violence and victim prosecution.

parsed.synthesis: The operative interaction is document or presentation discrepancy -> visa refusal or facility exclusion -> police arrest for trespass/disturbing the peace -> birth-sex custody, search and hormone interruption. Federal courts and statutes provide some recourse, and many states lack mapped facility bans, but in this division there is no gender-identity discrimination protection, local hate-crime coverage excludes gender identity, and the documented police response charged victims while arresting no attackers. Minors face layered care, sports, school and facility bans. This is state-imposed universal exposure with custody harm and thin local remedy, above the execution/imprisonment-certain tier but below administrative-only regimes.
